purpose: State a firm duty or determination once a premise is accepted.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Having made the promise, I will certainly keep it.
If you serve as representative, you should hear everyone’s views.
Now that I know the secret, I cannot simply remain silent.
restrictions: Commonly followed by responsibility, resolve, or an unavoidable consequence.
mistake: Read 上 as うえ; this is not the domain suffix じょう.
